items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: he said, 'Buck, what are you doing in here?' I said, 'I'm in here just like you are.'

ctx.x: But I mean you were promptly sort of put into a military band weren't you?

Yes, yes. But I was really supposed to have been shipped overseas so many times. When I went up into the Reception Center up in Camp Upton I asked where, Clifton Glover was up there before me and he was one of the leaders up there. He met all the recruits coming in. And one day he said he was standing out watching the new guys coming in and he saw me. He'd just got through, and I told you he directed the band at the Apollo Theater, he said, 'Buck, what are you doing in here?' I said, 'I'm in here just like you…

out of line."
So I got out of line and he pulled me right out of line and they told me to bring enough clothes for three days. I must have had forty pounds of clothes. I had all kinds of tailor made suits, khaki and khaki shirts and caps and things and I was kind of heavy carrying this. So he made me get out of line.
